tools.name: walkability_score
tools.description: How walkable one street spot in Europe is (31 countries). Give an address, or lat and lon. Returns the Walkably score from 0 to 100 (60% reach, 40% street quality; a very unpleasant street keeps the score from being high, and a place with nothing in walking distance scores low), the reach and street

tools.name: city_ranking
tools.description: A city's typical Walkably score (0 to 100, for where people live), its rank among the cities of the same country with a Walkably page (for example rank 1 of 36 cities in Spain; null when it is the only one), the median walk to each of eight daily needs, and up to five best and five least served area

tools.name: district_ranking
